//: ONE product version for everything. Loonext 1.3.0 means the same thing in
the web app, the API, and both store listings — because to a customer it IS
one product. A package-per-app layout would make 'what version are we on?' a
question with five answers, and would put semver on api/web, which deploy
continuously and are never installed by anyone.
So: a single root package. release-please owns version.txt and mirrors that
version into the Android versionName and the iOS MARKETING_VERSION via the
generic updater (the `x-release-please-version` markers in those files).
Build NUMBERS are deliberately not here — versionCode and
CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION come from the git commit count at build time
(monotonic by construction, see mobile.yml). This owns only the human-facing
